results.name: hud_message_process_all
results.evidence: iterates a data array via data_iterator_next and, for entries whose short field at offset+2 is not -1 (valid id), calls chimera__hud_message()
results.summary: Walks a generic data-array (register-passed) and dispatches chimera__hud_message() for every entry with a valid id field, used to flush pending HUD/chat messages before a profile switch.

results.name: player_profile_save
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint 'player_profile_save' matches; guards on DAT_00714dd4 (profile index) == -1 to print 'profile not saved since it was a default profile' via FUN_004c6860, otherwise calls FUN_0053a950(profile_index,&buffer) to actually persist it
results.summary: Saves the active player profile to disk unless it is the default (unsaved) profile, in which case it shows a status message instead, then refreshes the UI settings cache.

results.name: player_profile_refresh_settings_cache
results.evidence: copies per-profile blocks (indexed by profile*0x2004) into a compact per-controller struct (indexed at DAT_00710328+idx*0x217) and remaps 0-9 slider indices through hardcoded float tables (40..130, 80..260, 0.1x..4x) that match Halo's look-sensitivity/acceleration multiplier scales
results.summary: Converts a saved profile's raw settings (difficulty, name, 0-9 sensitivity/acceleration slider indices) into the live per-controller settings block used by the input and UI systems, mapping slider indices to actual float multipliers via lookup tables.

results.name: terminal_initialize
results.evidence: keeps existing non-FUN_ name; allocates the 'terminal output' data array via data_new and resets all console/terminal state globals, matching the referenced string
results.summary: Allocates the terminal-output data array and resets developer-console/terminal state globals.

results.name: console_message_new
results.evidence: calls datum_new() into the DAT_006b2f00 data array used by the console fade/draw code, evicting the oldest entry via FUN_00496490 first when the array is full (short at +0x2e == 0x20), then links it at the head of the DAT_006b2f04/DAT_006b2f08 list
results.summary: Allocates a new fading on-screen console message slot from the console data array, evicting the oldest message first if the array (max 0x20 entries) is full.

results.name: console_message_delete
results.evidence: unlinks the given index from the DAT_006b2f04/DAT_006b2f08 doubly linked list of console messages and calls datum_delete() on it
results.summary: Removes and frees one entry from the on-screen console message linked list.

results.name: console_open
results.evidence: guarded by DAT_006b2f0c == 0 (not yet active); installs the passed-in console/edit-line struct as the active terminal, computes its title string length, and calls FUN_00496c20 to restore the cursor and refresh the title
results.summary: Lazily activates the developer console/terminal for the first time, wiring up its edit-line structure and restoring the console cursor.

results.name: console_close
results.evidence: only acts when the passed handle equals DAT_006b2f0c (the active terminal); hides the win32 console cursor via GetConsoleCursorInfo/SetConsoleCursorInfo and clears DAT_006b2f0c
results.summary: Deactivates the developer console for the given handle, hiding the win32 console cursor.

results.name: console_process_queued_input
results.evidence: computes elapsed time via QueryPerformanceCounter/__alldiv, then while DAT_00712542 flags indicate 'not paused, scripted' and there is buffered input in the DAT_006b16fa/fc/fe ring buffer, feeds characters one at a time into the console edit line via FUN_0044c290
results.summary: Per-frame update of the developer console that feeds a queued/scripted stream of characters into the console input line one at a time, debounced by elapsed time.

results.name: console_message_expire_old
results.evidence: walks the DAT_006b2f04 linked list of console messages incrementing each entry's age counter at +0x120 and calls FUN_00496490 to free it once its age exceeds 0x96 (150) frames; renamed from the chimera__ hint prefix per naming rules
results.summary: Ages every on-screen console message each frame and deletes any that have been visible for more than 150 frames.

results.name: console_draw_overlay
results.evidence: reads the active terminal struct (DAT_006b2f0c), copies/reformats its edit-line text into a local buffer with a caret marker, then draws it via chimera__draw_8_bit_text, and separately walks the DAT_006b2f04 fading-message list drawing each with an alpha fade based on its age field (+0x120)
results.summary: Renders the developer console overlay: the current input line with a text caret, plus the list of recently faded console/hud messages above it.

results.name: console_printf_verbose
results.evidence: identical body to chimera__console_out but additionally requires DAT_0087ac06 > 3 before formatting/appending the line, suggesting a verbosity-gated print variant
results.summary: Formats a string with vsnprintf and appends it to the console message list, but only when a verbosity/debug-level global exceeds 3.

results.name: console_printf
results.evidence: renamed from chimera__console_out; formats the varargs string with __vsnprintf into a newly allocated console message slot (FUN_00496420), tags it as a command-echo if it matches DAT_00669140, and immediately echoes it via chimera__console_out_copy
results.summary: Formats and appends a message to the on-screen developer console, echoing it to the native win32 console/rcon as well.

results.name: console_restore_cursor
results.evidence: shows the win32 console cursor (GetConsoleCursorInfo/SetConsoleCursorInfo) when the terminal is visible, copies the terminal struct's name field into DAT_006b2dd8 as the window title, then calls FUN_004970a0 to redraw the input line
results.summary: Restores the console cursor visibility and refreshes the console window title/input line.

results.name: console_process_input_events
results.evidence: reads pending Win32 console input records via GetNumberOfConsoleInputEvents/ReadConsoleInputA and, for key-down mouse/keyboard events, forwards them to FUN_00490d10
results.summary: Polls the native win32 console for input events and forwards key-down events to the console key handler.

results.name: console_update_display
results.evidence: compares the cached title string (DAT_006b2df8) against the active terminal's current title (+0xb4) and redraws the input line via FUN_004970a0 if it changed, and repositions the cursor via FUN_004971a0 if the cached cursor offset (+0x1ba) changed
results.summary: Refreshes the console's displayed title/input line and cursor position only when they have actually changed since the last frame.

results.name: string_insert_at_occurrences
results.evidence: scans a haystack (in_EAX) for every occurrence of a needle (param_1) via FUN_00625430 and shifts memory to insert replacement text (param_2) at each match
results.summary: Generic helper that finds every occurrence of a substring in a string and inserts a replacement string at each match point, shifting the remaining text.

results.name: console_write_line
results.evidence: renamed from chimera__console_out_copy; forwards the pending line to chimera__rcon_out when DAT_006b2f1c is set, and otherwise writes the formatted line to the native win32 console via WriteConsoleA after substituting color tokens with FUN_00496df0
results.summary: Flushes the current console line to the rcon output and/or the native win32 console window.

results.name: console_clear_screen
results.evidence: reads the console screen buffer info then clears every character and attribute cell via FillConsoleOutputCharacterA/FillConsoleOutputAttribute
results.summary: Clears the entire native win32 console screen buffer.

results.name: console_clear_bottom_line
results.evidence: moves the console cursor to the last row via SetConsoleCursorPosition and, if requested, blanks that row with FillConsoleOutputCharacterA/FillConsoleOutputAttribute
results.summary: Moves the console cursor to the bottom row and optionally clears that row, used before redrawing the input prompt.

results.name: console_draw_input_line
results.evidence: formats "%s %s" from the window-title buffer and the terminal's input text (matching the referenced string), then writes it to the bottom console row with WriteConsoleOutputCharacterA; naming hints attached to this shared string ('server_list_menu_update' etc.) are false-positive collisions on the same literal
results.summary: Composes and draws the developer-console prompt/input line onto the bottom row of the native win32 console.

results.name: console_position_cursor
results.evidence: computes the on-screen column from the title-buffer length plus the terminal's cursor offset (+0x1ba), clamps it to the console width, and calls SetConsoleCursorPosition
results.summary: Positions the native console text cursor at the end of the currently typed console input.

results.name: interface_update_for_resolution_change
results.evidence: clamps the passed width/height to 640x480 (0x280/0x1e0) and stores them in DAT_00718f84/DAT_00718f88, setting a dirty flag (DAT_00718f82) when they differ from the previous values; matches the 'update_for_resolution_change' naming hint found nearby in this region
results.summary: Stores and clamps the interface's cached screen width/height, flagging a change when the resolution differs from the previous frame.

results.name: interface_update_screen_size
results.evidence: either queries the renderer's viewport size twice via FUN_006391b4 or the OS cursor position via GetCursorPos depending on DAT_00718f81, then forwards width/height to FUN_00497250
results.summary: Per-frame helper that obtains the current viewport size (or cursor position) and feeds it into the resolution-change tracker.

results.name: interface_draw_cursor
results.evidence: looks up the cursor bitmap width via FUN_0043f290(0) and, if present, draws it as a bordered bitmap via FUN_00498b20, otherwise falls back to FUN_00449780
results.summary: Draws the mouse cursor bitmap over the interface, or a fallback fill if the cursor bitmap has not loaded yet.

results.name: interface_update_loading_screen
results.evidence: renamed from chimera__do_show_loading_screen; drives the loading/saving progress state machine (DAT_00718f8c cases 2-9) based on elapsed ticks from FUN_00449210 and dispatches per-state cleanup/transition logic without issuing any draw calls
results.summary: Advances the timer-driven state machine for the loading/saving/connecting progress screen each frame.

results.name: interface_draw_screen
results.evidence: keeps existing non-FUN_ name; the code matches - it re-runs the same loading-screen state dispatch as chimera__do_show_loading_screen but then issues the chimera__draw_16_bit_text calls for each screen state, i.e. it is the drawing counterpart
results.summary: Draws the current loading/saving/connecting progress screen text and background for the active interface state.

results.name: interface_loading_screen_set_text
results.evidence: clears the loading-screen text buffer DAT_006b2f28 when called with a zero argument, otherwise calls FUN_00557990 (a string helper) to populate it
results.summary: Sets or clears the text shown on the current loading/progress screen.

results.name: interface_loading_screen_reset
results.evidence: resets every loading-screen related global (DAT_0068e680/4/8, DAT_00718f8c/90, DAT_006b2f28/68) to their inactive sentinel values
results.summary: Resets all state for the loading/saving progress screen back to its inactive defaults.

results.name: color_pack_argb_from_real
results.evidence: packs a float[4] RGBA color (0..1 range) into a single ARGB8888 uint via ROUND(x*255) per channel, the standard Blam real_argb_color->argb conversion
results.summary: Converts a floating point ARGB color into a packed 32-bit ARGB color value.

results.name: color_argb_scale_alpha
results.evidence: takes a packed ARGB color in EAX and a float scale factor, multiplying only the top alpha byte by the factor and leaving RGB untouched
results.summary: Returns a copy of a packed ARGB color with its alpha channel scaled by the given factor, used to fade UI elements.

results.name: widget_memory_pool_initialize
results.evidence: allocates a 0x20000-byte block with GlobalAlloc and stores it as the backing store referenced by the 'widget_memory_pool' string/pointer PTR_PTR_006926c4, then zero-initializes the heap header and the widget-slot array at DAT_00718f94
results.summary: Allocates and initializes the fixed-size heap used to allocate all UI widget instances.

results.name: widget_open
results.evidence: renamed from chimera__load_ui_widget; resolves the widget tag via tag_lookup, allocates it from the widget pool via heap_allocate, closes any existing widget already occupying the requested layer slot (DAT_00718f94), and calls FUN_00499780 to populate it from the tag data
results.summary: Loads a UI widget tag, allocates and initializes an instance of it, replacing whatever widget currently occupies the requested layer slot.

results.name: widget_close
results.evidence: renamed from FUN_00497c00; recursively closes/frees every child widget (via the 0x28/0x2c/0x34 child-list fields) before unlinking itself from its parent and siblings and freeing its own block back to the widget pool, then clears its slot in DAT_00718f94
results.summary: Recursively destroys a widget and all of its children, unlinking them and returning their memory to the widget pool.

results.name: interface_tick
results.evidence: large per-frame handler that measures elapsed time, polls the loading thread's exit code (GetExitCodeThread/CloseHandle), checks ui_check_for_pause_game and network_game_is_active, dispatches display_error, and updates widget-under-cursor selection state - i.e. the interface/menu system's main update routine
results.summary: Main per-frame update for the interface/menu system: advances timers, watches the background loading thread, and updates the active widget's input/selection state.

results.name: multiplayer_map_list_dispose
results.evidence: kept the existing non-FUN_ name since it is plausible but not fully confirmed; the body is a byte-for-byte duplicate of interface_tick's tail block that clears a 256-byte buffer (DAT_00712ccc) and, when a click/move flag is set, resolves the widget under the last cursor position and commits the highlighted list/slider selection before toggling the DAT_00712542 busy-flag bit
results.summary: Clears a small results buffer and commits the currently hovered list/slider widget's selection, toggling a busy-state flag; likely used when leaving a map/server list screen.

results.name: widget_draw_split_screen_region
results.evidence: builds a viewport rect using 320x480-ish (0x140) split-screen constants for a single local-player index (in_CX) and calls FUN_0049a8c0 to draw the active widget for it, but only ever executes for index 0 since its do/while loop runs exactly once
results.summary: Draws the active UI widget clipped to one local player's half of a split-screen viewport.

results.name: widget_draw_active_and_cursor
results.evidence: iterates the active widget slots, drawing each fullscreen (640x480) widget via FUN_0049a8c0, then draws a full-screen fade overlay from DAT_00718fa8 and finally redraws the cursor via FUN_00497380
results.summary: Draws all currently active full-screen UI widgets, an optional fade overlay, and the mouse cursor on top.

results.name: widget_list_get_child_by_index
results.evidence: walks a widget's first-child pointer (+0x34) forward through next-sibling pointers (+0x2c) in_EDX times and leaves the result in a register (no explicit return statement, consistent with a register-based calling convention)
results.summary: Returns the Nth child widget of a parent widget by walking its sibling linked list.

results.name: widget_close_all
results.evidence: closes the currently active widget tree (DAT_00718f94) via FUN_00497c00 if present, frees an associated list via FUN_004994b0, and if DAT_006953e8 is a valid sentinel also clears an 0xa0-dword results buffer at DAT_00712544 and resets flag bits in DAT_00712542
results.summary: Tears down the entire active widget tree and clears any cached list/results data associated with it.

results.name: widget_list_select_next
results.evidence: advances the selected index of a list-type (case 3) or scroll-container-type (case 2) widget by one, wrapping using its item-count field (+0x12), and plays the cursor sound via FUN_0049bb60/FUN_0049bba0
results.summary: Moves a list or scrollable widget's current selection to the next item, wrapping around at the end.

results.name: widget_list_select_previous
results.evidence: mirrors widget_list_select_next but decrements the selected index and wraps to the last item, using the same FUN_0049bb60/FUN_0049bba0 selection-sound calls
results.summary: Moves a list or scrollable widget's current selection to the previous item, wrapping around at the start.

results.name: main_menu_load
results.evidence: renamed from chimera__load_main_menu; on returning from an xdemo string comparison it closes any open widgets, calls widget_open on "ui\shell\main_menu\main_menu", surfaces any pending error via display_error, and initializes the virtual keyboard
results.summary: Loads and opens the main menu UI widget, handling demo-mode teardown, pending error display, and virtual keyboard setup.

results.name: main_menu_on_shown
results.evidence: when DAT_00718fc6 is set it looks up and starts the title-theme music tag, then if the active widget's +0x15 flag is clear it schedules a deferred transition (writes a trigger id and a deadline based on DAT_00718f9c) and frees a pending list via FUN_004994b0
results.summary: Starts the main menu's title music the first time it is shown and arms a deferred transition/timeout on the active widget.

results.name: bitmap_draw_scaled_bordered
results.evidence: builds a 4x4 grid of quads from a bitmap tag's border-width/height fields (+4/+6) and a destination rect, i.e. classic nine-patch corner/edge/center scaling, then hands the quads to FUN_0051c9a0 to render
results.summary: Draws a bitmap stretched to fill a destination rectangle while keeping its border corners/edges from distorting (nine-patch style scaling).

results.name: widget_list_get_tail_sibling
results.evidence: walks a widget's next-sibling chain (+0x30) to its end with an empty loop body, leaving the last node in a register for the caller
results.summary: Walks to and returns the last sibling in a widget's linked list.

results.name: widget_get_sibling_index
results.evidence: walks the parent's child list from its first child (+0x34) via next-sibling (+0x2c), counting steps until it finds the widget itself (unaff_ESI), returning that index or -1 if not found
results.summary: Returns the zero-based position of a widget among its parent's children, or -1 if it isn't found.

results.name: widget_set_state_recursive
results.evidence: sets a byte field at offset +0x10 on the given widget then recurses into every child via the +0x34/+0x2c child-sibling chain, applying the same value
results.summary: Recursively sets a state/flag byte on a widget and all of its descendants.

results.name: widget_play_sound_effect
results.evidence: switches on an enum (cursor/forward/back/flag_failure) and looks up the matching "sound\sfx\ui\*" tag before calling FUN_0049bdd0 to play it
results.summary: Plays one of the standard UI sound effects (cursor move, forward, back, or failure) selected by an enum id.

results.name: display_error
results.evidence: keeps existing non-FUN_ name; resolves the correct "ui\shell\error\error_*_{fullscreen,halfscreen,qtrscreen}" tag based on how many error dialogs are already queued and modal/split-screen state, then opens it via widget_open and stores the message id/timeout/modal flags on it
results.prototype: void __cdecl display_error(short error_string_index, int player_index, char modal, char is_error)
results.summary: Queues or immediately opens the appropriately-sized modal/non-modal error dialog widget for the given error message id.

results.name: interface_handle_quit_request
results.evidence: if DAT_00718fca is set it force-exits the process via ExitProcess after FUN_00542cf0, otherwise it arms a pending confirmation dialog (error id 0x23) either in the single-player or split-screen slot depending on DAT_00718fc9
results.summary: Either force-quits the game immediately or arms a 'are you sure you want to quit' confirmation prompt.

results.name: player_help_screen_select_by_name
results.evidence: lowercases the active profile's name and matches it (FUN_00625430) against a series of hardcoded name-list globals to pick one of ten "ui\shell\solo_game\player_help\player_help_screen_*" tags before opening it as a widget
results.summary: Selects and opens a specific player-help screen tag based on matching the current profile's name against hardcoded name lists.

results.name: main_menu_play_title_music
results.evidence: looks up the "sound\music\title1\title1" tag and starts it via FUN_00544090 the first time DAT_00718fc6/DAT_00719748 indicate it isn't already playing
results.summary: Starts the main menu's title theme music if it is not already playing.

results.name: list_node_prepend
results.evidence: allocates a node from the widget heap (heap_allocate), copies three fields from a template struct (unaff_ESI) into it, and links it onto the head of a list pointed to by unaff_EDI
results.summary: Allocates a small linked-list node from the widget heap, copies template data into it, and pushes it onto the front of a list.

results.name: list_node_pop
results.evidence: pops the head node referenced by in_EDX, copies its three fields out to in_ECX, advances the list head, and releases the popped node's memory via FUN_004d20a0
results.summary: Pops the first node off a small linked list, returning its fields and freeing the node.

results.name: widget_pool_list_free_all
results.evidence: frees every node in a linked list (unaff_EDI) back into the same widget memory pool (PTR_PTR_006926c4) used by widget_open/widget_close, following the identical free-list bookkeeping pattern
results.summary: Frees every node of a linked list back into the widget memory pool.

results.name: widget_create_children_from_tag
results.evidence: iterates a tag's list-item definitions and child-widget table, calling widget_open for each and linking the results into the parent's child list, then selects an initial default-focus child widget
results.summary: Instantiates and links in all of a widget's static child widgets (list items and nested widgets) as defined by its tag.

results.name: widget_initialize_from_tag
results.evidence: zero-initializes the new widget struct then copies type/position/flag fields out of the tag data block, calls widget_create_children_from_tag (FUN_00499540) to build its children, and for any embedded type-0x18 child calls FUN_0049a430
results.summary: Populates a freshly-allocated widget instance's fields from its tag definition and builds its child widgets.

results.name: widget_find_by_tag_id
results.evidence: recursively searches a widget's children (first-child at +0xd/next-sibling at +0xb) comparing each node's field 0 against param_2, returning the first match or itself
results.summary: Recursively searches a widget tree for a node whose id/tag field matches the given value.

results.name: widget_list_adjust_rect_for_scroll_arrows
results.evidence: for a list-type widget (+0xe==2) with fewer than 2 columns and valid up/down-arrow bitmap tags, shrinks/repositions the passed rect by the tag's spacing (+0x176) and clamps its height using the tag's +0x182 field
results.summary: Adjusts a list widget's layout rectangle to leave room for its up/down scroll-arrow bitmaps.
